modules.title: Bounded Motifs
modules.description: Stepwise and vakra 4-note motifs shifting strictly within S to Ṡ with zero octave wrapping.

modules.title: Cumulative Ceilings
modules.description: Progressive range expansions (S→M, S→P, S→D, S→N, S→Ṡ) anchored back to Shadjam.

modules.title: Bowing & Kala
modules.description: Separate bows (⊓ / ∨), 2-note Jodi slurs, 4-note Anga slurs across bar lines, and 2nd-speed Dvitiya Kala.

modules.title: Bounded Thirds
modules.description: Controlled single-skip intervals (leap ≤ 2) strictly bounded between S and Ṡ.
